Zoya Joshi
Java Developer | Bengaluru
zoya.joshi298@example.com | +91 9616899843

Detail-oriented Java Developer with hands-on experience building and maintaining backend services for fintech and healthcare domains. Strong focus on delivering reliable REST APIs, containerized deployments, and ORM-backed data layers with measurable performance and stability improvements. Immediate joiner.

Experience

Finlytics — Oct 2023 - Present
Java Developer | Remote
- Implemented Docker-based CI/CD pipelines for a transaction reconciliation service, reducing deployment time from 20 minutes to 4 minutes; used Docker to standardize runtime environments.
- Designed and developed REST APIs for payment settlement workflows, handling 60k requests/day with 99.95% uptime and average response times under 120ms.
- Optimized Hibernate entity mappings and queries, decreasing DB CPU utilization by 22% and improving monthly report generation time from 9 minutes to 3.5 minutes.
- Collaborated via Confluence and Jira to document API contracts and track sprint progress, enabling on-time delivery of three major releases.

Medisure — Aug 2023 - Sep 2023
Java Developer | Onsite
- Built and consumed REST APIs for patient record synchronization across services, achieving end-to-end sync latency under 2 seconds for 95% of transactions.
- Contributed to refactoring a monolith into Microservices for claims processing, isolating the billing service and improving fault isolation which reduced incident blast radius by 40%.
- Wrote integration tests and performed contract verification to ensure backward compatibility during microservice rollout.
- Coordinated tasks and tracked bugs using Jira; updated architecture notes and runbooks in Confluence.

Trellis Systems — Jun 2022 - Jul 2023
Java Developer | Hybrid
- Developed SpringBoot microservices for order management, processing 150k orders/month with automated scaling; used Docker for containerization across environments.
- Implemented Hibernate-based persistence layers with MySQL, introduced query indexing and batch operations that cut order reconciliation time by 55%.
- Exposed and documented REST APIs consumed by frontend and third-party partners; maintained API versioning strategy to support legacy clients.
- Managed deployments on Linux servers and used Jira/Confluence for sprint planning and technical documentation.

Projects
- Local Payments Mock Server — Built a Dockerized mock server exposing REST APIs to simulate payment gateway responses; used for integration testing across teams, reducing mocked test setup time from hours to minutes.
- Query Optimizer Dashboard — Small internal tool to visualize slow Hibernate queries and index suggestions for MySQL, leading to targeted DB fixes and a 15% improvement in average query latency.
